notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Loops through a subdomain list, resolves each via 'host' command, and filters only those resolving to company-owned IPs. Separates company-hosted subdomains from CDN/third-party delegations.

=== CHAINING ===
crtsh-unique-subdomains output → host resolution loop → filter to company IPs → feed to Shodan enrichment loop and nmap scan → third-party results excluded from active scope.

=== LEGAL SIGNIFICANCE ===
Subdomains resolving to third-party providers cannot be actively tested without explicit permission from that provider. This filtering step identifies in-scope vs out-of-scope targets — legally significant.
